The '''Mensaav Laboratory''' was a scientific research facility in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] region of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Republic superweapon initiative]] worked on the [[Death Mark laser]] in the military wing of the lab, and after [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] [[Attack on the Mensaav Military Laboratory|attacked]] the lab during the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Alderaan's native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] overran the complex. [[House Ulgo]] also began to experiment on the Killiks in another section of the lab.
